syntheticBinding.envScope: ris-dev2 only, exact profile + future expiry, default mode false

maysOrdersFinding.summary: Mays-Orders stores user-supplied agentOrder.metadata.apiProfileRef; prepare_dispatch checks order ownership but not that the referenced APIProfile belongs to the order owner/partner. RIS dispatch ingress resolves any ACTIVE contextRef and therefore cannot prove the binding.
maysOrdersFinding.risk: A Mays user able to create an agent order could reference another active APIProfile; RIS would execute under that profile's tenant/owner.
maysOrdersFinding.action: Server-side bind/validate apiProfileRef (and partnerApplicationRef) on order creation/prepare_dispatch, or introduce a signed server binding; do not change RIS to trust payload metadata.

stopConditions: synthetic binding accepted without persisted RUNNING row
any catalog/offer seed, real grant or global consent
